## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this Pull Request and which issue they resolve (e.g. `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New component (primitives, layout, token)
- [ ] Enhancement (improving theme compiler, CLI, performance)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)

## Quality Check List
Please check all that apply:
- [ ] I have followed the strict **Dart Dot Shorthand / Constructor Shorthands** code style rules documented in [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have used the correct aspect-specific theme extension methods (`context.justColors`, etc.) and avoided `context.justTheme` in build methods.
- [ ] I have verified that my code builds successfully and has clean static analysis.
- [ ] I have written unit tests or verified the change locally using target packages.
- [ ] (If adding a component) I have computed the SHA-256 checksum and updated `registry/index.json`.

## Screenshots / Videos
If this PR introduces any visual or motion changes, please include screenshots/recordings.
